row.title: Silent loops and frozen pages: a green run is not a landed result
row.body: Session: session_0156nqDu4uGc3HMjQ8qCqHyK. 2026-11-25 audit: seed kit-sync failed every scheduled run for 3 days unseen; /balance froze because only balance --gate ran; /changelog froze because it rode the product-manager PR, which went red and was superseded. foundation/selftest.py now checks every scheduled workflow in the org and every generated site data stamp, as failure-audit detectors.

title: Silent loops and frozen pages: a green run is not a landed result
